decisions.text: type line: a regular series whose pattern of change is the point (06 DP6-1, G1.51)
zero included (a narrow range far from zero wants an inset)

a narrow-range inset: the values lie in a narrow range far from zero (16.29 to 17.76: the gap from zero is at least their spread) and the small differences among them matter (facts.small_differences_matter); the main scale keeps zero, and the inset shows every mark on a truncated scale, 16–18 by 0.5 (G2.7)
each line its own colour, handed out top to bottom by the line ends: Consumer slot 1, Business slot 2
each line labelled at its end, in the text grey, packed in order: Consumer moved 0.41 line heights, Business moved 0.41 line heights
no point markers: no value is isolated and no straight run hides one
the unit's description on its own line above the scale (inline it would meet the line of Business): “revenue per month”; “$20 million” stays on the top label
digits hidden: millions, stated once on the top label (R2-05, D-3): “$20 million (revenue per month)”
time axis: row 2 (“2021”) left out, the title gives it (G2.37)
the inset's plot 83 pt high, as high as the main chart's (--inset-max-height; 132 pt at --inset-height-ratio)
the main chart compact, its plot half as high (inset.compact_main, s. 0081)

one time axis for the two panels, the main chart's, at the foot of the stack; the inset does not repeat it: space is short, the main chart is compact (inset.compact_main, the book's compact layout, s. 0081) (G2.27, D-56)
the inset above the main chart, spanning its width, at the same positions (s. 0081, s. 0297)

the inset's form: a frame round the band 15–20 of the main chart, across its width, a larger frame round a complete small chart (16–18 by 0.5, its unit restated on its top label (“$18.0 million (revenue per month)”), no category or time labels of its own, the main chart's axis serving both, no title, text at inset size), two links forming a widening cone, beneath the frames (G2.27)
the inset's lines are not faded; every value lies within its range (a line or dot outside it would be clipped at its edge) (G2.28)

source.shows: the narrow-range inset on lines: the main line chart keeps zero, so the two units look as steady as they are, compact under the inset (inset.compact_main, s. 0081), “$20 million” kept on its scale when the description moves to its own line; the inset above on the same months, 16.0–18.0 by 0.5 with “$18.0 million (revenue per month)” restated, as high as the main chart, both with their end labels; the compact layout shares one time axis, the main chart’s, under the stack; a frame round the main chart’s 15–20 band across its width
